changes: Payment design point: added that StockReserved with no payment_requests row makes the handler throw into the normal retry and DLQ path (Q3).
Events note: said each group reads every event including its own service's, and ignores the types it does not act on (Q6).
Where state table, Inventory: split reserve success from reserve failure; a rejected order writes no reservation row and changes no stock (Q7).
Rules, Throw means roll back: any throw, including a commit failure after the provider answered, counts as one attempt and the retry reuses the same key (Q2).
Rules, Retries and DLQ: said the consumer process waits in-process, blocking that partition for that group for up to about 71 s (Q5).
Rules: added Moves on (offset committed, later events flow) and DLQ contents (original event, found by orderId) (Q1, Q4).
Rules, Order Service guard: noted that a payment result for a cancelled order cannot occur in the normal flow (Q8).
Holes: added in hole 1 that on-call ownership and notification are undecided, and added hole 7 on a payment result for an already cancelled order with no automatic refund (Q1, Q8).
Added an Accept fails rule: POST /orders returns a 5xx on a failed transaction, with no order or outbox row, and the client learns the outcome only by email (answers Q14).
Added the atomic conditional UPDATE for the Inventory reserve step to the state table (answers Q15).
Added to the Moves on rule that the partition resumes in order after a successful retry (answers Q9).
Added an Inventory release guard rule: a PaymentDeclined for a RELEASED or missing reservation is acked with no change and no throw (answers Q10).
Clarified the Order Service guard: zero rows updated, processed_events still inserted, ack, no throw (answers Q11).
Spelled out the email_log unique key on (orderId, type) in the Email rule (answers Q12).
Specified that a DLQ replay goes to that group's consumer only, and added hole 8 for the undecided replay tooling (answers Q13).
Events section: stated the extra fields on OrderPlaced (item, qty, amount, paymentToken) and on OrderConfirmed/OrderCancelled (customerEmail), and where they come from (Q16, Q17).
Email decision: events carry customerEmail copied from the orders row, so Notification needs no lookup (Q17).
Added a 'Same request twice' rule with a requestId and unique key on orders, plus the requestId in the Order Service row of the state table (Q18).
Payment decision: the provider is called first with no transaction open, and the result is written in one transaction afterwards (Q19).
Added a short 'Consumer groups' note defining a group, its offset and instances (Q20).
Hole 6 widened to cover the customer email on the broker; DLQ contents rule now says the DLQ says nothing about reservations or payments.
Added an 'Open questions' section: source of amount, and number of consumer instances.
Reordered into the skill's layout: summary, terms, fixed rules, events, diagram with numbered step notes, second diagram, one failure table, state table, open questions.
Added a Terms section (outbox, relay, broker/topic, consumer group and offset, processed_events, DLQ, idempotency key, [txn]) answering the junior's what-does-this-mean questions.

Replaced the first Decisions table with numbered step notes after the main diagram: accept, same request twice, Inventory reserve, Payment record and charge, Order outcome, Inventory release, email. Each now states trigger, action, data written and failure handling.
Merged the scattered duplicate/failure rules (throw-means-roll-back, retries, moves on, DLQ contents, provider results, Order Service guard, email) into one failure table, each said once.
Merged the old Holes and Open questions sections into one numbered Open questions list at the end.
Moved the brief's fixed rules (accept, business rules, provider, errors, email) into a short Fixed by the brief list and removed their repetitions elsewhere.
Folded the Consumer groups note into the Terms and the Events extra-fields note into the Events section.
Cut repetition: the relay description and retry policy are stated once, and the per-service state table is shortened.

Kept both Mermaid diagrams unchanged. Kept every stated fact: 500 ms polling, oldest first, ack-before-mark, topic keyed by orderId, retries at 1 s, 10 s and 60 s, DLQ per group, paging, 71 s blocking, key charge:{orderId}, requestId unique key, conditional update, email_log unique key, the five decisions and all earlier holes.
holes: Q8: If a PaymentSucceeded arrives for an order already CANCELLED, what happens to the money and the reserved stock? (author: In the normal flow it cannot happen: Inventory emits one of StockReserved or StockRejected per order and Payment charges only after StockReserved, so a cancel and a PaymentSucceeded do not both occur. If it did happen (for example an out-of-order DLQ replay), the Order Service guard ignores the event, the card stays charged and stock stays reserved. The brief has no refund mechanism and I do not know whether one is wanted, so I added it as hole 7.)
